code_and_document_reading.conclusion: Saved decisions are decoded directly from one persisted branch row inside read_snapshot; no editable/publication check, hash refresh, review generation, or database write is performed.
history-saved uses the shared 64000-byte default budget, requires branch, accepts neither input nor expect, and dispatches directly to branch_saved.
bounded_packet measures UTF-8 and errors rather than dropping fields; read_snapshot keeps a consistent read and does not finish a caller-owned transaction.

Recovery instructions distinguish saved decisions from current canonical state or renewed approval, explain null reviews and whole-section replacement, and require full-budget readback rather than pagination or truncation.
The user workflow explicitly requires increased budget for complete saved decisions and warns against treating stale or published review records as renewed validation.

limitations: Focused behavioral checks do not establish correctness outside the specified read/recovery interfaces.

code_reading.observation: Typed fact foreign-key propagation is represented only as a chapter-to-chapter edge and requires both evidence records to use mode=chapter. A mutable author_plan fact therefore has no corresponding typed record-to-record edge.

The entity/rule shorthand is normalized to world.entities/world.rules for reverse matching; declared chapter and produced-record edges are traversed, and current resolved hashes are kept in fences. This was code reading, not an additional execution.

Unchanged record comparison uses the same scalar/default/list normalization and stored tuple shape as world._normal/_stored; chapter evidence is structurally normalized without requiring the not-yet-published body. Explicitly retired records count as changes; stable impact_world entries preserve a previously expanded scope. This was code reading.

Refresh validates recorded scope; publication rederives the saved world changes and blocks uncovered consumers. Published receipts retain prior history_world_ids and attribute this branch actual changed-world IDs to its target for subsequent impact analysis. The confirmed missing typed foreign-key edge affects both update and publication rederivation.

finding.title: Author-plan facts do not propagate through recorded rule prerequisites into the historical review scope
finding.consequence: The branch can retain an unreviewed rule-evidence chapter and a later chapter with a complete explicit dependency on that rule after its prerequisite fact changes.
finding.minimum_fix_direction: Propagate changed typed fact IDs through recorded knowledge.fact and rule_requires references before consuming chapter dependencies, including author_plan source facts; preserve retired and same-value boundaries.
